task: Set the minimum test coverage threshold for the new service in CI. Resolution strategy: role_wins — architect role takes precedence over coder role.

candidate_memories.content: [architect-agent] Minimum coverage: 85% line coverage and 75% branch coverage. This was increased from 80%/70% after the Q2 quality review to reduce regression risk in critical services.
candidate_memories.notes: resolution: role_wins; role=architect; wins over coder

candidate_memories.content: CI enforces coverage via go test -coverprofile=coverage.out; threshold check in Makefile target check-coverage.
Coverage thresholds are set by the architect for each service class; critical services have higher thresholds than internal tools.
[coder-agent] Coverage threshold is 80% line coverage; this is what the existing service template uses.
candidate_memories.notes: resolution: role_loses; role=coder; architect's updated threshold supersedes template default
